+8.0% day-over-day move (z-score 3.03) on 2022-03-01. Reasons given by 7 reports from that day:
- "Oil price rises above $105 a barrel ahead of OPEC+ meeting" (thecable.ng, 2022-03-01). Reported move: up 7%. Reason: OPEC and its allies adopted a production cut system to prop up prices and prevent an oversupply in the global oil market. Quote: "OPEC and its allies adopted a production cut system to prop up prices and prevent an oversupply in the global oil market" (source: 79bb2509b58f8742)
- "US and 30 allied countries to release 60m barrels of oil amid price surge" (theguardian.com, 2022-03-01). Reported move: up, size not stated. Reason: fears about supply disruption from the Ukraine crisis and sanctions against Russia. Quote: "fears about supply disruption from the Ukraine crisis and sanctions against Russia" (source: af369c3c276a10d8)
